_comment: Sellers whose listings must NEVER be imported. `authors` is matched by Facebook author id (the stable /user/<id> value captured during extraction); `olx_sellers` by OLX user id (`user.id` on the ad JSON). Add an entry to block a seller; the importers and the discovery scripts of BOTH sources honor this list.

authors.name: Timofeevich Vasilovich
authors.reason: user directive 2026-07-26: stop importing this seller

authors.name: Dan Daniel
authors.reason: user directive 2026-07-27: deals in wall/floor/mantel clocks, not wristwatches, so nothing he posts is importable. Observed in the 2026-07-27 sweep: 2087284375473544 'Ceasuri de perete funcționale, prețuri cuprinse între 200-350 ron' (bulk, price range), 2084763422392306 'Polaris, 31 zile, cheie' and 2084766165725365 '76 cm height, 30 cm width' (both floor/wall clocks). He accounted for most of that sweep's rejects.

olx_sellers.name: Dan
olx_sellers.reason: user directive 2026-08-12: six near-identical ads posted together, all boilerplate 'nou, sigilat, sticla sapphire' with vague titles and no brand on half of them, at prices no genuine example reaches — 306941267 'ceas longines sigilat' 700 RON, 306941259 and 306941272 'ceas tissot automatic sigilat' at 700 and 400 RON, plus 306941243/306941275/306941280 'ceas barbatesc (automatic) sigilat' 500-600 RON. A sealed new Longines or Tissot at those prices is a replica. Slipped past price_sanity because Longines' floor is exactly 700 and Tissot had no floor at all — the NEW_FLOOR_RON table added the same day now catches this pattern.

olx_sellers.name: watches.best
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-08-12: two listings (ad 307738324 Polar Vantage V3 at 1500 RON, ad 290102642 Apple Watch 9 Cellular at 1500 RON) both used screenshots of a retailer's product page as "photos" (visible price tags, star ratings, wishlist icons) rather than real photos of the item, and both asked roughly half the retail price shown in their own screenshots. Pattern reads as stolen/scraped images, not genuine sales.

olx_sellers.name: Mihail
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-08-13: ad 307338450 'ceas OMEEGA automatic' (misspelled Omega) at 600 RON, sealed/new, using the exact boilerplate 'Ceasul este nou ,sigilat ,sticla sapphire ,funcționează toate cadranele ,automatic ,cutie !' also seen the same session on ad 307317577 (dial reads HUBLOT, 400 RON) and ad 307400373 ('Pateek Philiippe', misspelled Patek, 500 RON) — all counterfeits, all far under the genuine brand's floor. Misspelled/altered brand names are a deliberate evasion of text-based brand matching.

olx_sellers.name: Dani
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-08-13: two near-identical ads (307621407 'CEAS Armani Premium Chronograph Blue' and 307621513 'CEAS Armani Premium Black Chronograph'), both 269-279 RON for a dial reading EMPORIO ARMANI, far under the genuine brand's floor, using AliExpress-style dropship spec-sheet copy ('ZAPHIRE' typo, 'STOC LIMITAT', 1-month warranty) rather than a private seller's own description — counterfeits.

olx_sellers.name: maxim
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-08-14: two ads (308088617 'Ceas Automatic, curea Silicon' rose gold/white dial, 308088010 'Ceas Chronograph' yellow/black dial), both 280 RON, both photographed with a dial reading HUBLOT GENEVE — Hublot's genuine floor is 8000 RON, so both are counterfeits.

olx_sellers.name: elctromax
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-08-15: ad 307319314 'Set de ceas analog si bratara pentru batbati' (Diesel, 600 RON) — both listing photos are literal screenshots of an emag.ro product page (visible iOS status bar, Safari address bar, 'Adauga in Cos' button, thumbnail strip), not photos of the seller's own item. Same stolen/scraped-retail-image pattern as seller watches.best (id 1377833468).

olx_sellers.name: Watch mania
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-09-06: two ads (308474821 'Casio g shock gmw 5000 METAL', 308474398 'Casio g shock roze SKY') both 500 RON — roughly 12-18% of genuine retail for the specific modules pictured (full-metal GMW-B5000 and Bluetooth/Solar GM-B2100PG-4A respectively; one ad's title even undersold its own photographed module, e.g. claiming plain-quartz GM-B2100D while the module number on the caseback read the pricier Bluetooth/Solar variant). Studio/catalog product photography, not personal snapshots, plus reseller boilerplate ('see our other listings'). Suspiciously-cheap fake pattern, same as other blocked resellers above.

olx_sellers.name: nb
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-09-06: two confirmed counterfeits from the same seller — 308914292 'Cartier Santos Large Black' (dial genuinely reads Cartier, 6000 RON vs Cartier's real ~47000+ RON new price) and 308913386 'HB Sourit of Bang 42 Black Ice Out' (dial genuinely reads HUBLOT, retitled 'HB' to dodge the 8000 RON Hublot brand-floor filter, 6250 RON vs tens of thousands EUR genuine). Both used dealer/catalog studio photography, cash-on-delivery-with-inspection language, a private seller offering a '12-month warranty', and 'full box sold separately' — a repeatable fake-reseller template. Seller also posted several more near-identical 'HB Spirit of Bang' colorway listings in the same ad-id cluster (308913344, 308913308, 308913275, 308913248) presumed to be the same counterfeit pattern.

olx_sellers.name: ThoughtfulTurtle484
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-09-07: two confirmed counterfeits, both genuinely reading 'AUDEMARS PIGUET' on the dial but titled vaguely as 'Ceas AP model 2' (308916363, 200 RON) and 'Ceas Audemara Piguet AP' (308916254, 180 RON) to dodge the 40000 RON AP brand-floor filter -- vs a genuine AP's real value. Both photographed with several near-identical rose-gold counterfeit cases/bracelets visible in the background (wholesale fake-stock photography), same pattern as the tray-of-counterfeits seen on a separate seller's fake Franck Muller (308916464) in the same tight ad-id cluster.

olx_sellers.name: Nosp
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-09-10: ad 308652834 'HB Square of Bang King Gold', 1599 RON -- dial genuinely reads HUBLOT (gold Big Bang Integral/Square skeleton chronograph), title deliberately garbled to 'HB Square of Bang' to dodge the 8000 RON Hublot brand-floor filter. White-glove product photography against a luxury-trunk backdrop, 'full box contra cost'. Same disguise template ('HB [Spirit/Square] of Bang') as seller nb (1380919799, blocklisted 2026-09-06) -- different account, same counterfeit-dealer pattern.

olx_sellers.name: Gabriel Mihai
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-09-11: four listings, at least two confirmed counterfeits. 308569122 'ceas barbatesc cronograf' (800 RON) photographs a dial genuinely reading HUELOT GENEVE, a misspelling of Hublot (diamond-bezel rose-gold Big Bang style), 10x under the 8000 RON Hublot floor. 308618347 'ceas Jeager-LeCoultre automatic' and 308554689 'ceas Jeager-LeCoultre reverse' (both 1200 RON, both misspelled the same way, missing the first a) are 1200 RON against JLC's 3000 RON floor -- the typo let both slip past price_sanity.py's brand regex before the 2026-09-11 fix added a misspelling alias for this exact case. All three share the identical boilerplate 'Ceasul este nou ,sigilat ,sticla sapphire ,funcționează toate cadranele ,[X] ,cutie !' plus 'Vizionați și celelalte anunțuri ale mele!' -- the same templated-counterfeit-dealer pattern as nb/Nosp above. Fourth listing (308617658 'ceas Seiko automatic', 900 RON, no brand-name disguise) not individually verified but withheld given the seller's pattern.

olx_sellers.name: Tlhu
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-09-11: two listings at absurdly HIGH prices rather than low ones, so price_sanity's floor check cannot see this pattern. 306308958 'Rolex Daytona 116508-0015 Cadran Meteorit' at 280000 EUR (genuine trades around 35000-45000 EUR) and 306251679 'Patek Philippe Grand Complications 5270P-001' at 430000 EUR both use the identical description line 'Autenticitate garantata (Compensare tripla pentru contrafaceri)' plus, on the Rolex ad, 'Suporta Verificarea Codului' -- Chinese replica-dropship spec-sheet boilerplate (triple compensation for counterfeits, supports code verification) machine-translated into Romanian, a phrase no genuine private seller or dealer uses. Photos are generic studio/catalog product shots on a plain pillow, not personal snapshots.

olx_sellers.name: Dial
olx_sellers.reason: observed 2026-09-13: ad 308861319 'Rolex Date - Just Blue Dial 41,mm', 6000 RON -- sits exactly on Rolex's price_sanity floor, a genuine Datejust 41 retails 8000-11000+ EUR new. White-glove studio product photo (watch held in hand against a designer trunk/bag backdrop), not a personal snapshot despite the ad's own claim 'Poze Reale'. Boilerplate reassurance copy ('Calitate Garantata - (TOP)', 'Satisfactia ta este siguranta platii', cash-on-delivery, contact via WhatsApp only) matching the templated-counterfeit-dealer pattern documented for nb/Nosp/Gabriel Mihai above. Generic non-name seller handle.
